The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to go to see a person or place.

draft.emotion: warm and friendly, looking forward to seeing someone special
notes: Combines ไป ('to go') and เยี่ยม ('to visit'). Used for visiting people (like friends, relatives, or patients), not tourist attractions (which takes ไปเที่ยว or ไปเยี่ยมชม).

senses.definition: To go to see and spend time with a person, such as a relative, friend, or someone in the hospital.

examples.text: พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะไปเยี่ยมคุณยายที่โรงพยาบาล
examples.translation: Tomorrow I will go visit my grandmother at the hospital.
examples.emotion: caring and concerned, speaking gently about a sick relative

draftBefore.shortGloss: to visit someone; to visit a place
draftBefore.emotion: warm and friendly, looking forward to seeing someone special
notes: ไป (pai) means 'to go' and เยี่ยม (yîam) means 'to visit'. When combined, they specifically denote going somewhere or to someone with the intention of visiting.
Do not confuse it with เที่ยว (tîao), which means to travel or go sightseeing for leisure rather than visiting a specific person or place out of care or courtesy.

senses.definition: To go to see a person, often a friend, family member, or someone who is sick.

examples.text: พรุ่งนี้ฉันจะไปเยี่ยมคุณยายที่โรงพยาบาล
examples.translation: Tomorrow I will go to visit my grandmother at the hospital.
examples.emotion: caring and concerned, speaking gently about a sick relative

senses.definition: To go to see a place, such as a tourist attraction, a new house, or an institution.

examples.text: พวกเราวางแผนจะไปเยี่ยมพิพิธภัณฑ์ใหม่สุดสัปดาห์นี้
examples.translation: We plan to go visit the new museum this weekend.
examples.emotion: excited and upbeat about an upcoming weekend trip

faults.why: Wrong initial consonant in second syllable; เยี่ยม is /jîam/, not /mîam/.

faults.quote: (travel) To go to see a place, such as a tourist attraction
faults.why: ไปเยี่ยม is used for people; visiting places or museums takes ไปเที่ยว or ไปเยี่ยมชม.
